variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.sub: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has changed the colony's charter. A change to the governing framework deserves a precise account, not a guess at the powers affected. In considering {target}, readers should distinguish the fact of amendment from any particular new permission or restriction not specified in this report.

The gazette records the amendment while avoiding an account of provisions not supplied here. A constitutional instrument and the administrative acts made under it are distinct matters. Public understanding requires accurate terms, and precision is especially necessary where a change in the charter invites broad assumptions about local power.

This paper examines {target} through the fact of the amendment, without announcing a specific legal effect not contained in the report. The exercise of authority and its justification merit separate scrutiny. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.
